messages:
Alex: Heads up — canary (eu) showing heatmap/sparkline stutter after last night's prefetch debounce tweak. Looks like hydration debounce + telemetry sampler causing duplicate KV prefetches. :eyes:
Priya: Seen it. Traces show two identical fetches within 60ms on initial load, main thread parse spikes. Profile attached.
Jordan: Can you paste trace snippet? Also which deploy rolled this in?
Alex: DeployBot rolled telemetry-sampler@v2 at 2026-03-10T02:14Z
Alex: Trace snippet:
```
fetch /kvcache/prefetch?key=heatmap-tiles  -> 200
fetch /kvcache/prefetch?key=heatmap-tiles  -> 200
main thread busy: v8 parse 120ms -> 320ms
```
Sam: Hmm. Debounce reduced from 300ms -> 50ms in rollout. That would allow two hydration attempts to both trigger prefetch. Revert or increase debounce?
Priya: Increasing debounce to 250ms fixed locally. But this only masks underlying double-init. We should avoid duplicated module init on hydration.
Jordan: Any chance routing policy sent first request to eu-a and second to eu-b causing duplicate code download too?
Alex: Yes — routing weight change last week split affinity; if first prefetch hits eu-a and second routed to eu-b we see duplicate bundle fetches + kv prefetch. Logs show different host headers.
Sam: Proposed immediate mitigation: (1) temporary rollback telemetry-sampler to v1 on canary, (2) bump hydration debounce to 250ms, (3) add client-side prefetch dedupe key by resource+route. Anyone object?
Priya: +1 on all. Add a small server-side header to indicate prefetch-inflight to help dedupe across regions.
Jordan: I'll open short PR for client dedupe today. If we can push hotfix before EOD we can avoid broader rollout rollback.
DeployBot: Scheduled canary rollback telemetry-sampler@v1 -> 2026-03-11T18:00Z by @Sam
Alex: Ok thanks — keep y'all posted. If you see it, drop stack trace here. :thumbsup:
Priya: Filed perf ticket PERF-1029 with sample traces and repro steps.
Sam: I'll coordinate a patch and ping QA. Thanks team.
